_readme: Human decisions about which legacy tenants migrate. Hand-maintained and checked in.
This file is an INPUT to `npm run migrate:cohort`; the generated report in
reports/cohort.json is overwritten on every run, so decisions must live here.
Key each entry by company id (safest) or by the exact cleaned name shown in
reports/cohort-review.md. An override outranks every scoring rule; a key that
matches nothing is reported as a warning rather than ignored.
decision: "include" | "exclude"  ·  reason: why  ·  by: who decided
signedOffBy names the person accountable for this cohort. Phases 3-7 refuse
to run while it is null. It lives here rather than in the generated report
so that re-running the cohort script cannot silently drop the signature.
